mapper.select:
SELECT ACCT_NO id, ACCT_NAME text, CCY object /*多级法人改造，增加STL_CAPACCT_INFO.SEQ_NO查询字段 add by caojin 2020/6/12 start */ ,SEQ_NO seqNo /*多级法人改造，增加STL_CAPACCT_INFO.SEQ_NO查询字段 add by caojin 2020/6/12 end */ FROM STL_CAPACCT_INFO
ACCT_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR ACCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%'))

SELECT T1.CASH_ID cashId ,T1.CCY ccy ,T3.ACCT_NO busiAcctNo ,T3.ACCT_NAME acctName ,T2.EFF_DATE effDate
,T2.BENCHMARK_ID indexId ,T2.BENCHMARK_TYPE indexSource ,T2.INT_TYPE rateType ,T1.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType ,T2.BASIS basis
,T2.RATE * 100 as rate
,T2.RATE as currentRate ,T2.COEFFICIENT coefficient ,T2.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate
FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T2 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T1 ON T1.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.ACCT_NO
T1.CASH_ID = #{cashId} AND T2.EFF_DATE = TO_DATE(#{effDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT T3.ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, T2.CASH_ID cashId, T2.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, T3.ACCT_NAME acctName, /*多级法人改造，增加STL_CAPACCT_INFO.SEQ_NO查询字段 add by caojin 2020/6/12 start */ T3.SEQ_NO seqNo, /*多级法人改造，增加STL_CAPACCT_INFO.SEQ_NO查询字段 add by caojin 2020/6/12 end */
T1.INT_TYPE rateType,
CASE T1.INT_TYPE WHEN '01' THEN T1.RATE * 100 ELSE (T1.RATE*T1.COEFFICIENT+T1.SPREAD_RATE) * 100 END AS rate
,CASE T1.INT_TYPE WHEN '01' THEN to_char(T1.RATE * 100,'fm9990.99999') ELSE T4.ITEM_VALUE||'*'||to_char(T1.COEFFICIENT,'fm9990.0099999')||'+'||to_char(T1.SPREAD_RATE*100,'fm9990.0099999') END AS rateStr
,T2.CCY ccy ,T1.EFF_DATE effDate ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T3.ACCT_NO order by T1.EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T2 ON T1.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID
LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST T4 ON T4.DICT_CODE = 'SECRATE_DATA' AND T1.BENCHMARK_ID = T4.ITEM_CODE
INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T3.ACCT_NO
AND (T1.EFF_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{effDateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{effDateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD'))
AND T3.ACCT_NO = #{busiAcctNo}
select INDEX_ID id, INDEX_NAME text from MST_INDEX_INFO
SELECT COMPONENT_ID componentId, COMPONENT_TYPE componentType, WEIGHT weight FROM MST_INDEX_COMPONENT WHERE INDEX_ID = #{indexId}
SELECT CLOSE_PRICE FROM MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION WHERE MARKET_ID = #{indexId} AND ROWNUM = 1 AND EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{effDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY EFF_DATE DESC
SELECT YIELD FROM MST_YIELD_CURVE_INFO WHERE CURVE_CODE = #{indexId} AND CURVE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{effDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY CURVE_DATE DESC
SELECT MAX(T2.EFF_DATE) FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO T2 ON T2.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = #{acctNo}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM FIN_RATE_INFO WHERE CASH_ID = #{cashId}

SELECT CASE T1.BENCHMARK_ID WHEN NULL THEN NULL
ELSE T1.BENCHMARK_ID END AS indexId
,T1.INT_TYPE rateType
,T2.INT_RATE * 100 rate ,T2.EFF_DATE effDate ,T1.COEFFICIENT coefficient ,T1.SPREAD_RATE * 100 spreadRate FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN MST_INT_RATE_INFO T2 ON T1.BENCHMARK_ID = T2.INT_RATE_ID
AND T2.EFF_DATE >= (SELECT MAX(EFF_DATE) FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T3 WHERE T3.INT_RATE_ID = T1.BENCHMARK_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{effDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND T2.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{platDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND T1.CASH_ID = #{cashId}
order by T2.EFF_DATE desc

SELECT * FROM( SELECT T1.CASH_ID cashId ,T1.CCY ccy ,T3.ACCT_NO busiAcctNo ,T3.ACCT_NAME acctName ,T2.EFF_DATE effDate ,T2.BENCHMARK_ID indexId ,T2.BENCHMARK_TYPE indexSource ,T2.INT_TYPE rateType ,T1.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType ,T2.BASIS basis
,T2.RATE * 100 as rate
,T2.RATE as currentRate ,T2.COEFFICIENT coefficient ,T2.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate
FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T2 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T1 ON T1.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.ACCT_NO
1=1 AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T2.EFF_DATE != TO_DATE(#{effDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd')
ORDER BY T2.eff_Date DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
